UC vintage = first cash flow year; WSIB vintage = year of initial investment date (WSIB multiples are rounded to 1 decimal). UC 2020 snapshot rows are used for funds no longer in UC's 2025 active list. Insight VIII appears twice (two LPs, two dates) and the results differ widely. Quartiles: the Cambridge Associates USVC book at the given URL downloaded but is a 7-page public summary (index returns only, no vintage TVPI quartiles); Carta pages returned 403. The two Carta quartile entries are unchanged from the earlier search-summary read and were NOT verified in a document; bottom quartile still missing.
